established: A rule can act: a checker identified by the hash of its code accepts by replaying.

opened.text: A counterexample changes the repository, whoever brings it.
An agent with no preparation can use Warrant correctly.
The circle of witnesses widens by evidence, without an admin.
The specification rebuilds itself under evidence.

residual: a goal proves nothing: it sets the direction of path search; it is shown met only by a superseding transition that establishes it
